title: Aromatic Spanish Lamb Gambas Al Ajillo
description: Rich and flaky Spanish dish featuring lamb stock and double rise bread, served in a salt block vessel, this recipe is a nostalgic and flavorful experience, and is also fodmap friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the double rise bread into 1 inch thick slices.
Place the bread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the bread slices and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
Bake the bread in the oven for 10 minutes or until lightly toasted.
In a large skillet, heat the lamb stock over medium heat.
Add the garlic, paprika, and shrimp to the skillet and cook until the shrimp are pink and fully cooked.
To serve, place a toasted bread slice on each salt block, spoon the shrimp and lamb stock mixture over the bread, and serve immediately.
